acquisition_is_solved.method: k6_minimum_adequate_policy_cover_v1.minimum_policy_cover, exact, checked against an independent exhaustive search; validity confirmed by mapping the returned labels back to plans because _normalize returns reprs, not plans
acquisition_is_solved.reading: acquisition is not the constraint. Four experiences, exactly, licence every distinguishable situation for task A -- and one for task C. The number of experiences needed was never the open question.

composition_is_a_separate_wall.reading: each rule is verified by the demonstration that taught it; the check is LOCAL, so a local check cannot see a global revert. 'N verified skills' is not evidence about a sequence of two, and real coding work is a sequence.

conclusion: The claim is right about acquisition and wrong about yield. Acquisition is exact: four experiences licence every distinguishable situation on the measured environment, and no fewer will do. But one-experience memory serves 4.81% of real edits end to end -- one in twenty-one -- and 0 of 14 multi-line edits. On top of that, verified pieces do not compose: two individually accepted skills produce a sequence whose net change is nothing, and every local check passes both steps. So 'learn each once and everything is solved' is false by two measured factors, neither of which is learning speed. The single bottleneck is not how fast the system learns; it is that real work is mostly not repetition, and that the correctness of a sequence is not implied by the correctness of its steps.

REFUSE.share: unmeasured, and the least honest number in this tree
REFUSE.why: where no mechanical postcondition exists, the correct output is a refusal, and this tree has not measured how much real work that is

SYNTHESISE.why: novel or needs a value the demonstration cannot supply; 31 of 64 wrong predictions were exactly this constant_differs class

what_would_move_it: raising recurrence (it rises with time in one repository: 0.149 -> 0.394 by chronological quarter, and saturates under 40% of gross)
raising determinacy on the inductive remainder (54.9% today)
measuring the REFUSE share, which nobody has
whether_learning_rate_is_the_bottleneck.why: learning rate multiplies a term that is already small. Making acquisition infinitely fast leaves the fraction of work that memory can serve unchanged at 4.81%, because that fraction is a property of the WORK, not of the learner.
